mechanism.baseline: Tile-major P4K execution: each C512 tile traverses all 64 layers and commits before the next tile.
mechanism.candidate: Layer-major execution: gather a complete prompt slab, process all C512 tiles of one layer before advancing, and synchronize and commit once after all 64 layers.
mechanism.implemented_scope: P513..P4096, C512, SM87, no trace callback
limitations: Every layer/tile still stages into and publishes from the existing C512 scratch with two device-to-device copies.
Projection kernels and weight reads remain C512; this version does not yet execute one large-M projection per layer.
The cross-layer residual/RMS fusion is disabled because its normalized scratch cannot survive intervening tiles.

real_api_direction_gate.workload: P4K complete natural ShareGPT conversations; one warmup and four measured requests
real_api_direction_gate.common_composition: retained long-context FlashInfer attention plus the existing optimized Prefill projection/GDN routes

nsys_directional_attribution.comparison_warning: The NSys comparison uses the immediately preceding optimized-attention ELF rather than the same layer-major-capable ELF; it has attribution authority only. The real API direction gate above is the same-ELF decision authority.
nsys_directional_attribution.finding: The extra D2D slab traffic and loss of the residual/RMS fusion outweigh the synchronization reduction while projections remain C512.

validation.first_token_semantics: unchanged for all measured P4K requests

decision: Do not retain this implementation as a performance baseline and do not expand its statistical matrix. Keep the default-off layer-major execution surface because it is the required integration point for a future one-layer large-M projection or persistent-weight dataflow; remove the two D2D copies and restore/fuse residual normalization before retesting.
